channel.title: Lena Fuhrimann - Talks, Podcasts & Writing
channel.description: Conference talks, podcast appearances, articles and open source from Lena Fuhrimann - cloud engineer, founder of bespinian, and public speaker on cloud-native, DevOps and Kubernetes topics.

item.title: Home Assistant: Open Source Home Automation
item.description: If you want to automate your home with open source, there's no way around Home Assistant. Over the past few years the project has built a huge community and become the de facto standard - even proprietary smart home products that advertise local, cloud-free operation now have to support it to succeed. A look at the background of the project and practical examples from real-world use. (Chaostreff Bern · Bern)

item.title: A Practical Guide to Fast and Private LLMs
item.description: Running LLMs fast and keeping your data private often feel like competing goals, especially once you move away from the big cloud APIs. A practical guide to deploying LLMs that are both performant and privacy-respecting - the tools, trade-offs, and architecture decisions that actually make a difference. (Nine TechTalk #29 · Zürich)

item.title: A Practical Guide to Fast and Private LLMs
item.description: A practical walkthrough of running LLMs locally and on-prem - covering model selection, inference performance, and keeping sensitive data out of third-party hands. Given as an internal Tech Talk at Karakun. (Karakun Tech Talk · Basel)

item.title: Run Your Own LLM for Profit and Sovereignty
item.description: Why running your own LLM makes sense - both as a business decision and as a matter of data sovereignty. A practical look at self-hosted models, the tradeoffs versus managed APIs, and how to get started without a data center. (Swiss Software Festival 2026 · Basel)
